''See also: [[Li Markuth Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Li]] Markuth, also known as Markuth, is a powerful figure within the [[Li clan]], serving as its [[Grand Patriarch]] and later as its [[Grand Elder]]. A winged combatant capable of manipulating [[wind]], [[Shadow|shadow]], and [[vital aura]], he possesses significant strength that allows him to command respect from clan elders. In his earlier life, he held the rank of [[Archlord]] before ascending to greater power. Markuth is a formidable opponent who has engaged in violent conflicts, including the execution of a Wei descendant and battles against [[Jade]]-level experts. His history is marked by a confrontation with the [[Abidan]], specifically [[Judge Suriel|Suriel]], which resulted in his banishment. After returning to [[Cradle]] through [[Way|the Way]], he seeks to restore his clan's status and lead them toward dominance, utilizing both [[sacred arts]] and techniques mastered in other worlds.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Li]] Markuth is a man with white-striped hair and dim white flesh that radiates an unrestrained [[hunger]]. He possesses black-veined white wings that span fifteen feet on either side of his body. As a [[Gold]], his physical form is partially composed of [[madra]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Driven by the intention to claim all of [[Sacred Valley]] as his own personal territory, [[Li]] Markuth is a winged terror. He has faced legal consequences for attempting to dominate local [[inhabitants]] and committing spatial violations.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Li]] Markuth is a winged terror who was banished by [[Judge Suriel|Suriel]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|He can call [[Wind aura|wind aura]] and utilize a [[Striker technique]] to create emerald cyclones. His repertoire includes a [[Forger technique]] shaped like an ancient warrior's fist, a [[Ruler technique]] that increases air pressure using [[soulfire]] and otherworldly wisdom, and a song from his heart that forms invisible razors. Additionally, he wields a space-cutting [[sword]] and a sentient parasite weapon compatible with [[Storm madra|storm madra]], while living storms remain bound within his wings.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Archlord of Cradle}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|An [[Archlord]] upon his departure from [[Cradle]], [[Li]] Markuth possesses the ability to call forth [[Wind aura|wind aura]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c35">''Waybound'', chapter 35</ref> His wings contain bound living storms, and his dim white flesh emanates an unrestrained [[hunger]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c35" /> In combat, he wields a [[sword]] capable of cutting through space alongside a weapon he created that acts like a sentient parasite compatible with [[Storm madra|storm madra]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c35" /> He can utilize a song stored in his heart to either shatter minds or form invisible razors.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c35" /> Markuth further employs various techniques, including a [[Ruler technique]] fueled by [[soulfire]] and otherworldly wisdom to increase air pressure, a [[Striker technique]] to create emerald cyclones, and a [[Forger technique]] shaped like an ancient warrior's fist made of dark [[green wind madra]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c35" />}}
